intent: Organize the rpgman project: initialize git + cogitlog, add repo hygiene (.gitignore, README), make the initial commit
context: rpgman: Rust+Tauri+SvelteKit D&D 2024 character manager. Core idea — every stat is a traceable list of contributions (source+op+value+condition); rules live in editable JSON data files; the Rust engine interprets them. State: crates/engine complete, 33 tests, 0 warnings; all 12 classes + 12 subclasses + 3 species + 4 backgrounds + feats authored under content/. GUI shell not built yet.

body: Track cogitlog reasoning history in git but ignore the ephemeral session pointer. Commit .cogitlog/sessions/*.jsonl, index.jsonl, config.json, AGENTS.md, and the top-level COGITLOG marker so reasoning history travels with the repo and diffs stay human-readable. Gitignore .cogitlog/current (machine-local pointer to the active session) and *.sqlite (in case a future cogitlog version adds a binary DB) to avoid binary/churn noise.

alternatives.reason_rejected: history wouldn't travel with the repo

body: Split the single root commit into 4 logical, buildable-in-order commits: (1) chore scaffolding — workspace Cargo.toml/lock, .gitignore, README, cogitlog; (2) feat(engine) — crates/engine src (compiles standalone); (3) feat(content) — content/ JSON data + FORMAT.md; (4) test(engine) — tests + examples (need engine+content). Order chosen so each commit builds on the previous: engine compiles after #2, content is pure data #3, tests that load content pass only after #3.
